pre_registration.ritual: CLAUDE.md 6.2 Epistemic Integrity Pre-Registration (Program E-001). These rules are fixed BEFORE any capture or diff runs so no result can be reverse-fitted.
pre_registration.h4_grid_alignment: MEASURED, never assumed. TradingView's OANDA:XAUUSD H4 bars are exchange-session anchored; the engine's are calendar-true broker-time buckets, and the resolved broker offset is +3 (odd) so broker 00:00/04:00/08:00 map to UTC 21:00/01:00/05:00 — the two grids may not align 1:1. Candidate anchors are scored by actual OHLC agreement exactly as engine_data.resolve_offset does, inheriting its D-2 anchor-floor rule (the winner must have matched EVERY usable anchor before its mean error is trusted). FAIL CLOSED: if no candidate is decisive the sidecar keeps status=NOT_APPLICABLE with reason=H4_GRID_UNRESOLVED. An unresolved grid is a recorded absence, never a pass.
pre_registration.match_tolerance_basis: Inherited, not re-chosen. engine_data.MATCH_TOLERANCE=3.0 and DECISIVE_RATIO=5.0 are defined for a single M15 bar's summed O/H/L/C L1 error. An H4 bar aggregates 16 M15 children, so absolute error scales with aggregation. DECIDED IN ADVANCE: the H4 comparison applies the SAME numeric MATCH_TOLERANCE=3.0 to the per-bar L1 error of the aggregated H4 OHLC (open=first child's open, close=last child's close, high=max, low=min — all four are single price points, not sums, so the L1 error does NOT scale with 16). No tolerance is widened after seeing a number.
pre_registration.corpus_boundary: data/XAUUSD_M15.csv covers 2026-07-07 01:00 -> 2026-08-06 23:45 broker. shot 01_h4_july_macro requests Jul 1 -> Aug 7, so Jul 1-6 has NO engine bar at all. That span is reported as NO_ENGINE_BAR rows and counted in the denominator — never silently dropped to flatter the match rate.
pre_registration.smc_claim_split: Two DISTINCT claims, never blended. MECHANICAL = independently verifiable against the sidecar's own stored TV bars (e.g. the PDH/PDL reference level equals the prior day's max/min of TV bars; an FVG's edges equal the gap between the recorded bar pair; a Zone reported active is not already mitigated per _geometry.is_mitigated). A mechanical failure is a defect. VISUAL = human judgment on the annotated PNG; a visual mismatch alone is INSUFFICIENT EVIDENCE pending user adjudication, NOT a defect. Report row 8 upgrades only for what is mechanically proven.
pre_registration.new_finding_condition: A new F-id is registered ONLY IF H4 reconciliation finds genuine OHLC divergence beyond the inherited tolerance, or a mechanical SMC check fails. A null result (H4 grids agree, SMC checks pass) updates the existing Notes on F-075/F-076/F-079 and registers NOTHING new — a clean measurement is not a finding.
pre_registration.verdict_vocabulary: The closed CLAUDE.md 6.8 set only. No row says 'bug' without naming the violated contract.
